dataset: GEO GSE149438, n=300, test n=45, externally preprocessed
note_lr_perfect_auc: Logistic Regression achieved AUC=1.0 on this 45-sample test set. This is an artifact of the small test set (38 cancer / 7 healthy) and strong linear separability of GEO fragment features. LR 3-fold CV AUC=0.975±0.014 is the more reliable estimate.
note_class_imbalance: 84.7% cancer prevalence. Dummy classifier accuracy = 84.7%. CNN+LSTM accuracy (88.6%) is only 3.9pp above dummy. AUC-ROC and AUPRC are the primary metrics.
